_comment: Policy for scripts/rpc-contract.mjs. ignoredCaptures are captured RPCs/classes outside the extension's scope; allowedUnhandled are in-domain captured RPCs intentionally deferred; knownDuplicates must stay empty (each RPC key maps to exactly one handler).
_neverHandleComment: Player actions. A passive extension must never register a handler for these: an extension that places, destroys or unlocks on the user's behalf is a bot, which SECURITY.md forbids outright. rpc-contract.mjs asserts nothing here is ever registered, so this is enforced rather than merely stated.
_deferredComment: Reads with no current consumer. Unlike neverHandle this is a backlog, not a rule - each is only worth handling once a feature needs it. Adjudicated against the forge-hammer peer on 2026-09-27: getUnlockCosts (we compute unlock costs geometrically), getItemAmount (no inventory-listing feature), getPlayerAutoRefills and getGreatBuildingInventoryForGreatBuilding (no consumer) were all judged to have no counterpart here. Absence of a captured sample is NOT evidence a handler is unnecessary: 9 of the original 20 had no sample only because the user had not entered GBG/Quantum/Expeditions that session. Re-triage when a related feature is designed.
